name: Ship it
description: Ship it: commit what a worktree task left, push its branch, open or update its PR; follow its checks and reviews, fix conflicts with a follow-up, squash-merge the reviewed head and fast-forward the user's checkout.

settings.title: Follow PRs I link: a GitHub PR link in a prompt or follow-up attaches that PR to the task, with its checks and reviews
Fix merge conflicts by itself: when a task's PR has conflicts, its agent is asked to fix them without waiting for you

Keep PRs green (Steward), ticked in Ship it by default: the task fixes its PR's failing checks and new review comments, wisp pushes; review also has another vendor's model review each push. Never merges

commands.title: Fix a task's PR conflicts: the task merges its base in
Keep a task's PR green (the Steward): fix, review (fix + another vendor's review of each push) or off
